paper.title_en: Entanglement and apparent thermality in simulated black holes
paper.abstract_en: We investigate the apparent thermality of Hawking radiation in the semi-classical limit of quantum black holes using the mean-field limit of a chiral spin-chain simulator, which models fermions propagating on a black hole space-time in the continuum. In this free-theory regime, no genuine thermalisation occurs. Nevertheless, we show that a bipartition across the event horizon yields a reduced density matrix whose mode occupations follow an apparent thermal Fermi-Dirac distribution. In contrast, partitions away from the horizon do not exhibit such thermal distributions, reflecting the absence of thermal behaviour. Our results demonstrate that Hawking radiation appears thermal only with respect to horizon bipartitions in free theories, with genuine thermal behaviour expected to emerge only in the presence of strong interactions deep in the black hole interior, a study of which we leave for future work.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文在半经典极限下用凝聚态模拟器研究霍金辐射的表观热性，并提出视界二分与远离视界二分的热分布差异，主题契合黑洞热力学与全息/凝聚态交叉方向，理论上清晰且结论有条件限定，值得进一步阅读；引用数据缺失，未计入社区信号。
decision.title_zh: 模拟黑洞中的纠缠与表观热性
decision.abstract_zh: 我们利用手性自旋链模拟器的平均场极限，研究量子黑洞在半经典极限下霍金辐射的表观热性；该模拟器在连续极限中建模了在黑洞时空上传播的费米子。在这一自由理论区域，并不发生真正的热化。尽管如此，我们表明，跨越事件视界所作的二分会产生一个约化密度矩阵，其模式占据数遵循表观的热费米-狄拉克分布。相反，远离视界的划分则不呈现这种热分布，反映出热行为的缺失。我们的结果表明，在自由理论中，霍金辐射仅在相对于视界二分时才显得是热的；真正的热行为预期只有在黑洞内部深处存在强相互作用时才会出现，对此的研究我们留待未来工作。
